subject: bella-vargas
label: Hot rod, not hot mechanic
from: Black hair. Coveralls unzipped to the navel, sleeves knotted at the waist
to: STEEL-GREY AND CHERRY-RED. COMPRESSION SHORTS, SPORTS BRAS, G-STRINGS. SHE HAS NEVER OWNED COVERALLS.
note:
THE HAIR IS A HOT ROD. Steel-grey and cherry-red, and Viraena said it twice so the Archive would not file it as a colour description: LIKE A HOT ROD. Primer and candy paint. The Grease Queen is wearing her own trade on her head and the Archive put BLACK, which is what a mechanic's hair looks like in a stock photograph.

THE WARDROBE IS NOT WORKWEAR. Compression shorts, sports bras, g-strings. That is the inventory. No coveralls, no boiler suit, no knotted sleeves — the Archive dressed her out of a garage-calendar cliche and then had her unzip it, which is a costume the family does not own and would not tolerate under the panty doctrine anyway.

SHE WORKS IN WHAT SHE WEARS. Nothing is put on to do the job and taken off afterward. That is the difference between a woman with a trade and a woman dressed as one.

CORROBORATED BY VIRAENA’S OWN REFERENCE ART, handed over AFTER this correction was filed and matching it without a single adjustment: STEEL AND CHERRY HAIR, GREY SPORTS BRA, GREY COMPRESSION SHORTS, bent over an engine block in the garage. THE ONLY THING THE PICTURE IS MISSING IS THE GREASE AND THE OIL.

AND SHE HAS A REASON FOR THE RULE, IN HER OWN WORDS: COVERALLS MAKE HER ASS LOOK FLAT. That is the whole objection and it is not vanity dressed as practicality — it is practicality and vanity agreeing for once. THE FULL WORKING OUTFIT IS THREE THINGS: COMPRESSION SHORTS, SPORTS BRA, UTILITY BELT. The belt is the piece the Archive had never recorded, and it is the piece that makes the rest a UNIFORM rather than an outfit.

THE SHORTS DO THE OPPOSITE OF CONCEALING AND THAT IS THE POINT. They contain — the whole plump round dome of each cheek held and separated rather than draped over — and they pay for it. THE PAIR IN THE REFERENCE IS NEARLY TRANSLUCENT ACROSS THE SEAT, worn through by forty-six inches and a mission, and she is still wearing them. BELLA VARGAS DOES NOT RETIRE A PAIR OF SHORTS FOR GOING SHEER. She retires them when they split.
